# Paramedic
1. Your direct superior is the Chief Medical Officer.
2. Paramedics are to retrieve the corpses or injured bodies of crewmembers to bring to the medical bay for treatment.
3. Paramedics are to perform triage services and basic first aid to patients when needed, before their transfer to the medical bay.
4. Paramedics have the access they are expected to have, and should not seek out additional access at the beginning of a shift.
5. If a Paramedic is unable to enter a private or secure area to provide rescue, they may forcefully enter a department with the approval of the Chief Medical Officer.
6. Paramedics should carry sufficient supplies for each major damage type (burn, brute, poison, airloss, and bloodloss, and radiation).
